full_page.content:
Page 124 Cont.
Feb. 10 Emil Malinowski - 35 - drinks, neglects wife and three small chil- dren, sleeps and misses work.
Margaret Peck - 47 - Threatened by man - a gangster - who never work - whom she hopes to convert.
Page 125
Feb. 13 Paul Simkiss - 41 - away from home since last May. Till that time everything was ideal .... has wife and four living here in Detroit.
13 Mrs. Irene Andette - 44 - Baptist - Serious Eye trouble - nervous - Enrolled To-day in Ser. Masses. ..
Raymond Gallagher - 16 - Very serious bowel trouble - enrolled Today
14 Eileen (Schmid) McGuire - married last Wednesday to a P.F.C. from the Alutian Isles; Very sick for some time - in Providence Hosp. since Xmas.
Lucile Menard - 43 - blind .... lives with her father and brother and wife. They ask for prayers that they find some one to help .... 2921 Sheridan - Olive 5780 after 4 P.M.
Mrs. M. Schonherr wants girl or Woman to help with 4 small children - not very well - 14276 Eastwood ... Ar. 0128 -
Howard Sheridan - 50 - unconscious from Sunday last week till Thurs. - four Drs. absolutely gave him up .... Pray.
Page 126 Feb. 15 Pauline Gann - 21 - in Kiefer's - cured of spinal maningitis last Saturday after being unconscious in Oxigen tank from Monday Now Drs find spot on lung.
16 Michael Angelo Cassar - 59 - has wife and 3 at home (now in Ann Arbor Hosp.) tumor in left lung, very threatening.
20 Victoria Moskal 0 48 - fearful head-aches from tumor in ear - fears mastoid. Enrolled.
Mrs. Josephine Sancome - 65 - threatening condition of lungs. Mother of large family .....
Mrs. Marg. Caton
